codeReview.summary: This feature produced a single documentation artifact: tests/e2e/benchmark-full-mode.md (52 lines). No source code changes were made — this was purely an E2E benchmarking task. The benchmark report is well-structured with a clear results table (3 prompts × runtime/quality/steps/notes), summary statistics, quality methodology, review-triggers-fix flow evidence, and observations. The handoff provides strong verification evidence: 6 command-line checks (bun test, typecheck, 3 log greps for Queue timestamps, ERROR line count) and 5 interactive checks confirming each run completed with dynamic step insertion and review-fix flow. Log timestamps corroborate the reported runtimes (1254s, 1004s, 1667s). All 3 validation contract assertions (VAL-E2E-FULL-001..003) appear satisfied.

issues.description: No reusable E2E test script was produced. The e2e-tester skill procedure says to 'Write the E2E test script' in tests/e2e/, but the worker ran interactive tmux sessions manually instead. While justified for a benchmarking task (real API calls, 10-28 min per run, quality assessment requires human judgment), future benchmarks won't be reproducible without manual re-execution. A parameterized script could at least automate the TUI interaction portion.

Quality scores are all identical (4/5) with identical rationale ('focused narrowly on the prompt rather than considering broader architectural implications'). This uniform scoring reduces the signal value — the YAML config parser run (1667s, 12 steps, 5 review fixes, 6 test fixtures) arguably demonstrated higher complexity and artifact quality than the hello world endpoint (1254s, 12 steps), yet both received the same score. More granular differentiation would be useful.

The produced code artifacts from each run were git-reset and not preserved as evidence. While this is per the feature spec (git reset between each run), there's no way to independently verify the quality scores. A future improvement could snapshot the git diff between runs (e.g., save to a timestamped patch file).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The e2e-tester skill procedure assumes all E2E tests result in reusable bash scripts, but long-running benchmark tasks (3-10 min per run, real API calls, subjective quality scoring) don't fit this pattern well. The worker deviated from the skill and suggested the skill 'could include guidance for long-running benchmark tasks vs quick automated tests'. This is a valid gap — the skill's Work Procedure step 3 says 'Write the E2E test script' unconditionally.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker skillFeedback.deviations[0]: 'Ran interactive tmux sessions manually via Execute tool rather than writing a reusable bash script'. skillFeedback.suggestedChanges: 'E2E tester skill could include guidance for long-running benchmark tasks vs quick automated tests'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker used FLYWHEEL_SKIP_APPROVAL_GATES=true to auto-approve gates during E2E runs. This env var is documented in AGENTS.md config table but isn't mentioned in the mission AGENTS.md's E2E Run Procedure section, nor in .factory/library/environment.md. The mission AGENTS.md does mention 'Approval gates: Skipped' but doesn't explain how. Workers doing E2E runs need to know about this env var.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Benchmark report header: 'Approval gates: Skipped (FLYWHEEL_SKIP_APPROVAL_GATES=true)'. Mission AGENTS.md E2E Run Procedure says 'For HITL questions: select No, handle automatically' — but worker still needed FLYWHEEL_SKIP_APPROVAL_GATES for approval gates specifically.

summary: PASS. The e2e-full-mode-runs feature successfully executed 3 E2E pipeline runs in Plan+Work+Review mode (option 3), producing a well-structured benchmark report committed at be4b62b. All 3 prompts completed with 0 errors: 'add a hello world endpoint' (1254s), 'add a health check endpoint that returns uptime' (1004s), 'add a YAML config file parser' (1667s). Mean runtime 21m48s. Quality uniformly scored 4/5. Review-triggers-fix flow confirmed working in all runs (14 total review fixes applied). Dynamic step insertion verified (7→11-12 steps). The only deliverable is a markdown report — no source code changes. Three non-blocking issues noted: no reusable test script produced (skill deviation), uniform quality scoring reduces signal, and produced artifacts not preserved for independent verification. Two shared state observations: e2e-tester skill lacks benchmark-specific guidance, and FLYWHEEL_SKIP_APPROVAL_GATES usage pattern not documented in mission-level docs.
